digest.title: Jensen Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO, board chair
digest.tldr: Trump says he spoke to the board and that Huang "did nothing wrong."

digest.title: Jensen Huang scheduled to testify next week in Senate following reinstatement as Nvidia CEO
digest.tldr: The public hearing follows bipartisan calls for Huang to testify about the affair with the suspected Chinese spy.

digest.title: Microsoft Azure flaw exploited to steal customers' API credentials
digest.tldr: Microsoft is warning customers that a security vulnerability in Azure API Management (APIM) Classic tiers was exploited to steal stored API credentials, with Norwegian authorities linking the flaw to cyberattacks…

digest.title: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo
digest.tldr: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo, an open-source runtime for Linux.  It helps teams protect running systems while they roll out patches.

digest.title: Finding faster quantum algorithms with agents and formal verification
digest.tldr: Using agent teams and formal verification to improve quantum algorithms for fusion and chemistry.
